resource.title: University of Washington CSE 440 Introduction to HCI: User Interface Design, Prototyping, and Evaluation（课程主页，含项目 milestone、作业与日程，往季存档公开）
resource.covers: 官方课程描述：整门课围绕一个小组设计项目，学生要 Ideate and Propose Design Problems → Study Existing Practices and Challenges → Explore Potential Design Opportunities and Tradeoffs → Evaluate and Iterate Upon a Design；学习目标明确写 Design Research Methods and Skills、Task-Focused Scenario Development / Sketching / Storyboarding、Rapid Prototyping and Iteration、Critical Perspective on Design Solutions。对应节点里的访谈类用户研究、原型、交互流程、可用性实验与迭代；量化 UX 评估（问卷量表/统计）较少。

courses.course: CSE 440 Introduction to HCI: User Interface Design, Prototyping, and Evaluation
courses.prereq_text: Catalog Description: ... Prerequisite: CSE 332.  Prerequisites: CSE 332

courses.course: UXD 260 User Experience Research and Evaluation
courses.prereq_text: In this course, students will gain practical skills in core user research and evaluation methods, including expert inspections, interviews, and usability testing... UXD 210 is the prerequisite for this class.

extra_prereqs.evidence: UW CSE 440 官方先修写 CSE 332（数据结构与并行）

notes: V.2.1 判 supported 靠 DePaul：UXD 260（用户研究与评估）明写 'UXD 210 is the prerequisite for this class'，而 UXD 210 的官方描述是 user and task analysis、interaction design、prototyping、evaluation 加 human perception/cognition，正是 V.2.1 节点内容。反例也记下：UW CSE 440 自己就是入门 HCI 课，只要求 CSE 332，不要求先修 HCI，说明『UX 方法课』在美国课程体系里常常直接开在数据结构之后。资源选 CSE 440：主页与往季存档（如 24au）公开课程描述、milestone 序列与作业，能照着走完一遍『研究→原型→评估→迭代』；DePaul UXD 260 只有目录描述、没有公开材料，故只作先修证据。
